meetings.headline: Zoning board approved all four special permits, including a new Subaru dealership with a 15-foot minimum setback.
meetings.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard four special permit applications in a row. Roll-call responses were given on each, and the chair announced each as approved. The first took most of the night: a new Subaru dealership on Chase Road, where the board debated the 20-foot setback, a curbed landscape island, fire access and car-carrier unloading. The other three were a Cove Road garage, a PSG Realty garage on Leominster-Shirley Road, and a Sunset Lane house and garage.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals approved all four special permit applications heard at the meeting, each by roll call.
The Empire Management (Subaru) permits at 757 Chase Road passed with a condition setting a 15-foot minimum from the edge of pavement.
The board approved front setback relief at 45 Cove Road and a reduced front setback for a new six-bay PSG Realty garage.
The board approved side yard setback and height relief at 12 Sunset Lane; the applicant is to email revised plans the next morning.
No member of the public spoke on any of the four applications, and nothing else is scheduled for the rest of April.

why_it_matters: These approvals set how close a new car dealership, garages and a house may sit to the street and lot lines, which determines what gets built in these neighborhoods and how traffic and emergency access work around it.

The Chase Road decision attaches conditions to the dealership's parking and display near the road, so neighbors and drivers on that stretch are affected by how those conditions are written and enforced.
